name: NUPACK 4
summary: Nucleic-acid thermodynamics, structure analysis and sequence design.

steps: Read the official NUPACK 4 license and select the permitted use case; download the package through the user's own authorized account.

Check the official supported Python versions and architecture, then install the user-obtained package into a new isolated environment on Linux/macOS. Windows users need WSL2 for this documented route.
Run the official package-version and pytest checks without submitting sequences to any web service.
install.verify_note: Use the official pip show nupack and pytest --pyargs nupack checks after the user supplies the licensed package.

notes: NUPACK's downloadable Python package is not assumed to be an unrestricted public PyPI package; license acceptance is a user action.
